data.description: A map of strings which should be statically set as the resources `output`.

output.description: A copy of the `data` attribute, as it was during resource creation.

triggers.description: Can be used to force a re-creation of the resource and therefore will update the `output` attribute.

block.description:
Creates static data assignments.

The **data** map will be copied to the **output** attribute during resource creation. 
**output** values won't change during resource updates, only on re-creation.
